scope: Targeted end-to-end source/build review of pinned display and ordinary-buffer application-compute paths. Not a line-by-line proof of all Linux/FreeBSD/Mesa/Apple code; no new hardware validation.
hardware_proven: UHD 770 PCI matching and i915 attach progressed.
H610 LPC discovery and PCH_ADP selection work after the enumeration repair.
Both HPD tables initialize; GEM/display probe and scan-out allocation complete.
Generic scan-out vmap is refused; no usable framebuffer was published.
The system can keep running after signal loss.
candidate_repairs_not_hardware_verified: Use CPU-mappable GGTT scan-out and balance pins/VMA/wake references.
Validate the framebuffer range before exposing it to macOS.
Reject missing VBL timer allocation.
Retain the original guard on both port attach and framebuffer publication failure; remove the claim on failed publication.
Initialize framebuffer allocation bounds before drm_client_register synchronously invokes hotplug, and preserve callback errors.
Disable FBC on the diagnostic Alder Lake-S path because direct WindowServer writes do not implement Linux frontbuffer damage notifications.
Implement software VBL registration/enable/disable/unregister with in-flight target references and stop/rearm synchronization.
Retry preferred/1080p/720p/1024x768 bounds on reported capacity/modeset errors, with atomic checks and mapping cleanup between attempts.
Track registered-client ownership: an initial registration callback failure keeps pins until DRM unregister instead of freeing an owned client.
Synchronize attach cancellation, power/shutdown operations and detach; never free a device after a timed wait while its probe still runs.
Reject failed framebuffer power transitions instead of acknowledging them as successful.
Normalize packed 1/3-channel 8/16-bit IOFramebuffer gamma tables and commit through the existing DRM legacy-to-atomic color path.
Treat CLUT as unsupported for the sole direct XRGB8888 format; validate connection/color-depth requests and report failed power changes.
Only signal attach completion after its final stage logging, so stop cannot tear down shared services while attach still logs.
Retain native IRQ work loops under the BSD interrupt-list lock; draining no longer dereferences a cookie that teardown can free.
Reject zero/wrapping DMA ranges, unsafe IOKit mapping spans, oversized page lists and bus-DMA total sizes before exposing an address.
Copy real connector EDID and progressive timings into a stable-ID one-display snapshot; reject invalid EDID and modes outside the immutable scanout allocation.
Implement native DDC/mode enumeration, atomic interactive mode commits with rollback, and generation-based connection notifications.
Serialize hotplug, mode switch, gamma and power transactions; mode catalog replacement runs through IOFramebuffer's gated connection check/probe rather than asynchronously racing count/enumeration.
Refresh copied state from kConnectionCheckEnable, which Apple's connection-change path calls even when kConnectionProbe is not called.
Destroy the operation mutex on duplicate/full-slot/client-init failure and final DRM unregister; the host fixture accounts for those resources.

Keep DRM hotplug callback delivery alive after refresh errors by recording failure in the snapshot/open result instead of triggering the core's permanent hotplug_failed latch. Explicit reprobe still reports the transaction error.
Only mark NMX_MODE_PREFERRED timings as default in connectFlags, matching the mode information API.
Connect ANV macOS BO mappings to NMX node ioctls, including nonzero offsets and whole-map ownership; do not advertise incomplete placed/reserved/external-FD/modifier paths.
Retain GEM shmem WB/WC/UC page pins through native map lifetime; unmap before page-unpin/GEM put; refuse unsupported GTT/FIXED/TTM user mappings.
Track every taskqueue active executor, serialize repeat execution, wake cancelled drain waiters and wait for worker/external executors before freeing queues.
Convert only Darwin/i915 NMX provider absolute deadlines from Mesa monotonic remaining duration to kernel-compatible uptime; preserve poll/infinite/error/overflow semantics.
known_display_limitations: Software VBL callback lifetime now has a real implementation and host concurrency tests; actual display-IRQ pacing is not implemented by this software timer.
Gamma now has a DRM atomic commit implementation and host conversion/error tests; visible color behavior remains hardware-unverified. Indexed CLUT is not applicable to the advertised direct format.

Single-connector dynamic modes/DDC/notification code is implemented. Only progressive modes inside the original scanout dimensions are exposed; allocation growth, multiple outputs and interlaced/doublescan/3D modes are unsupported.
The GGTT mapping candidate intentionally holds an awake reference; sleep/wake is not established.
acceleration_gaps: A matched offline candidate now contains NMXGPU, NMXAccel, real ANV/libdrm/loader, Metal frontend/translator and Vulkan/Metal readback probes. It has no installer or activation and hardware_ready remains false.

NMX ioctl mapping and synchronization boundaries now have implementation and host/native clock tests. Real DMA/IOMMU behavior, GPU command completion/cache visibility and correct readback have no success evidence on this UHD 770.

The ordinary Metal buffer/texture path uses ANV allocations, but NMXAccel inherited family GPUVA/VRAM callbacks still require NVIDIA RM and are not implemented for Intel. Hardware pools and family-managed shared presentation remain out of scope.
Apple private MTLIOAccelDevice initialization may invoke unsupported family callbacks; successful source compilation cannot establish that the ordinary-buffer path avoids them.
plugin/NVMTLDevice.m::nvmtl_process_is_allowed still explicitly rejects Intel WindowServer. Removing this check is not an implementation of Intel IOSurface/resource/completion/presentation contracts.
Hardware VBL pacing, full sleep/wake, multi-output and video codecs are not completed by this application-compute candidate.
api_checked_not_a_bug: IOFramebuffer.getPixelFormatsForDisplayMode returning zero is required by its Apple header; it is not an unsupported-format bug.
The public IOGraphics color definitions confirm RGB mode bit 0x1 and 8-bit RGB depth bit 0x2; those existing answers were not a color-enumeration bug.

IOService normal provider termination finalizes clients before provider stop; nmx_fb_unpublish is only called from that stop path. This does not certify arbitrary manual stop or native runtime lock ordering.
source_flow_review: xnu/nmx_kext.cpp: opted_in, start/attachThread/attachNow, boot guard, claim, power and stop ordering.
bsdcompat/src/nmx_port.c and nmx_bus.c: attach_on, child driver selection, native PCI class discovery and detach ownership.
i915_driver.c, intel_display_driver.c, intel_opregion.c, intel_hotplug_irq.c and intel_ddi.c: probe stages, optional OpRegion, PCH/HPD and tunnel configuration.
drm_client.c and drm_client_modeset.c: framebuffer allocation, callback ownership, synchronous registration hotplug and probe bounds.
intel_fb_pin.c, i915_vma.c and nmx_i915_scanout.c: GGTT placement, aperture mapping, VMA/fence/object/wake reference pairing.
intel_fbc.c, intel_frontbuffer.c and intel_fbdev.c: compression policy and missing damage/invalidate/flush integration for the macOS aperture writer.

xnu/nmx_fb.cpp and Apple IOFramebuffer.cpp/.h: range/mode/DDC APIs, software VBL, interrupt registration, gated connection resense and stop/unpublish ordering. The connector code is implemented and host-tested; native scheduling/output remain hardware-unverified and hardware VBL pacing is not implemented.

Acceleration paths: NMXAccel family boundary; real ANV/NMX BO map ownership, GEM page pinning, taskqueue active execution and NMX clock conversion; real frontend/translator build and offline Apple AIR decoding. Ordinary application compute is separate from unimplemented Intel family allocation/WindowServer contracts. Native device initialization and GPU execution remain unverified.

compilation_evidence.result: 900 DRM/AMD + 274 i915 + 76 runtime units compiled; host fixtures including persistent GEM pins and concurrent taskqueue lifetime, required-symbol definitions and temporary native KC preflight passed. Nothing installed/loaded and no GPU executed.

verified_artifact.name: nmxgpu-build
verified_artifact.verification: Downloaded ZIP matched GitHub artifact SHA256; compile/gate evidence inspected. Kernel commit is declared from independent run metadata, not an internal commit log.

compilation_evidence.source_compatibility: git diff confirmed all kernel workflow/source pins/patches/tools/kernel and workqueue fixtures unchanged from ca325c3 to userland/Metal source 2d3165d.

All kernel and matched userland/Metal components compile; independent artifact digest verification and offline kit assembly (passed)

policy: No more one-reboot-per-return-code instructions. Batch statically established fixes first. Do not promise one hardware test can prove complete support.

host_verification.platform: Windows MSVC 2022 with /W4 /WX; actual patched helper headers and complete bridge function bodies, mocked IOKit/DRM services only
host_verification.callback_lifetime: Passed dispatch, disable, invalid handles, concurrent/self unregister, retained targets and stop/rearm checks
host_verification.display_bridge: Passed fault/ownership/mode scenarios, including registered-client failure, partial allocation, generic AMD mapping, operation-lock cleanup, explicit reprobe errors and failed-then-successful connector delivery under DRM's sticky callback-error contract
host_verification.attach_lifetime: Passed cancellation/admission/drain checks and 200 concurrent completion/stop races
host_verification.limits: These tests do not model IOKit scheduling, actual DRM locking, GPU/IOMMU transactions or visible output. macOS compilation is a separate gate.
host_verification.gamma: Passed 1/3-channel 8/16-bit, interpolation, unaligned input, maximum/invalid metadata and bridge commit/error tests
host_verification.irq_drain: Passed filtering, reference balancing and cookie teardown injected immediately after list unlock in the actual patched BSD drain function
host_verification.mapping_arithmetic: Passed zero, overflow, inclusive endpoint and page-span checks in the shared helper; native DMA/IOMMU transactions are not modeled
host_verification.display_protocol: Passed actual bridge mode switch/rollback/reconnect, stable IDs, fixed-allocation limits, invalid EDID, timing bounds and one-based DDC block checks on Windows; native IOFramebuffer scheduling remains a hardware boundary.
host_verification.native_display: Actual extracted IOFramebuffer method bodies passed mode/timing/DDC/error checks, fixed pitch, disabled/pending connection notifications, unchanged catalog before notification, and state replacement through kConnectionCheckEnable on Windows. Apple service internals and controller gate scheduling are mocked, not certified.
host_verification.gem_mapping: Actual generated i915 shmem mapping lifecycle fixture passed pin/unpin/native-map failure and ownership cases; native DMA/IOMMU behavior remains unverified.
host_verification.taskqueue: Extracted production taskqueue fixture passed actual multi-thread active-executor cancellation/drain/free checks under MSVC and macOS CI.
host_verification.clock: Actual NMX deadline helper fixture and macOS CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW versus mach_absolute_time smoke passed; no native GPU fence completed in this check.

hardware_test_readiness.policy: Do not activate or request a reboot from build success alone. The matched offline candidate has no installer/activation; concrete recovery and automatic logs are still required.
hardware_test_readiness.first_mvp: Single 8086:4680 device, ordinary ANV buffers, finite GPU compute and complete changing-input readback; separate Metal initialization/compute gate.

Prepare persistent/automatic logs before any GPU load so signal loss does not prevent evidence collection
unverified_runtime: Real PCI/IRQ/DMA/IOMMU operation and basic visible output with this batch
Real ANV command submission, completion, mapping/cache visibility and readback
Private MTLIOAccelDevice initialization and ordinary-buffer Metal compute
outside_first_compute_mvp: Intel family GPUVA/VRAM callbacks and cross-process shared presentation
Hardware VBL delivery, full sleep/wake, multiple outputs and video codecs
